W.note: Assembles the Figma logo mark piece for piece (half-pill top-left, coral, purple, blue, green circles), which breaks the no-logo rule; otherwise a clean staggered scatter-and-assemble with a seamless opacity-0 seam.

X.note: Selection-handle idea is a nice Figma nod, but the starburst's CSS transform overrides its SVG translate, so it sits clipped in the top-left corner instead of beside the square.

Y.note: All motion is periodic sine/cosine, so the loop is mathematically exact, but the orbiting, drifting, and bobbing shapes read as a generic shape screensaver with no designed choreography.

Z.note: Uses Figma's exact palette and shape vocabulary (quarter, half, circle, squircle, pill) on a dark glow without copying the logo, with staggered eased assemble, stretch, and scatter that returns exactly to its start.
